title: Why you miss things right in front of you

scenes.say: Most phone talkers missed the clown.
Attention works like a narrow spotlight. What falls outside it can go unseen, even in plain sight.
It may be why you miss a friend waving at the metro gate while on a call.
In one study, a clown rode a unicycle across a campus square. Only a quarter of people on calls noticed. About half of solo walkers did.

data.title: Noticed the clown
data.source: Hyman et al. 2010, Applied Cognitive Psychology

scenes.say: One explanation: a call pulls attention inward. In the classic gorilla study, about half of viewers missed a gorilla.
Meeting someone? End the call before you arrive. Send this to the friend who walks past you mid-call.

data.text: What did you walk past today?
